name: Arnold Pierson Beveridge and Marion Priscilla Delano
known: The family memoir reports a 1926 wedding and the name Marion Priscilla Delano. A separate institutional Tri Delta digital index contains the form 'Beveridge, Marion Priscilla Delano'; FamilySearch's compiled profile points to indexed death and obituary sources. A separately published 1940 federal census index for Sharon, Massachusetts lists Arnold P. Beveridge (born about 1904) and Priscilla D. Beveridge (born about 1901), along with other Beveridge names, as residents of the same town.
limits: An archival *name index* and a compiled FamilySearch profile corroborate that the full married name appears elsewhere, but do not independently establish the husband, wedding or birth/death dates. The published citywide alphabetical 1940 index does not itself show that Arnold and Priscilla shared one household or state their relationship; inspect the underlying census household image before using it as marriage proof.
status: Full name has independent catalog corroboration; marriage remains a research lead
